allowedInstances.title: Approved ServiceNow instances
allowedInstances.description: Only these instances can be enabled. Exact https origins (https://acme.service-now.com) or wildcards with at least two names after *. (*.corp.example.com matches its sub-domains, not corp.example.com itself). An entry that is neither is ignored; a list with no usable entry allows no site. Leave unset to let people enable their own instance.

aiProvider.title: Required AI provider
aiProvider.description: anthropic, openai (OpenAI or a company gateway), azure (Azure OpenAI: aiBaseUrl is the resource address https://<name>.openai.azure.com, allowedModels are deployment names), gemini, mistral, groq, deepseek, openrouter, ollama or custom. Not case-sensitive; a name Agent Buddy does not know allows no provider.

aiBaseUrl.title: Required AI endpoint
aiBaseUrl.description: Address of the organisation's AI gateway, for example https://ai-gateway.corp.example/v1. https only (http only for localhost or 127.0.0.1), no user name or password, no ?query or #fragment; compared without a trailing slash or :443. An address that is not valid blocks every AI call.

allowedProviders.title: Allowed AI providers
allowedProviders.description: Provider ids people may choose from, for example ["openai", "azure"] to rule out every other vendor (such as deepseek). Not case-sensitive. An empty list allows no provider. aiProvider, when set, must be on this list.

allowedModels.title: Allowed models
allowedModels.description: Model ids (for Azure OpenAI: deployment names) people may use; the first is the default. Exact and case-sensitive.

piiMode.title: Minimum personal-data protection
piiMode.description: standard masks detected personal data; strict also refuses sensitive fields and HR free text; local-only refuses any AI endpoint that is not on this computer. People can choose a stricter mode, never a looser one.

previewMode.title: Show what will be sent
previewMode.description: always shows the exact outgoing text before every AI call; first shows it the first time per feature (and every time when the request carries text from other tickets or articles); never skips it. A minimum: people can choose to see it more often, never less.

keyStorage.title: Where the AI key is kept
keyStorage.description: local = Agent Buddy's own database in this browser (an IndexedDB vault of the extension, which ServiceNow pages cannot open); session = memory only (chrome.storage.session, closed to content scripts), cleared when the browser closes; encrypted = the vault holds the key encrypted with a passphrase. Applied exactly.

providedApiKey.title: AI key supplied by the organisation
providedApiKey.description: Optional. When set, people never enter a key. Used only when this policy also pins aiProvider or aiBaseUrl, so the key never goes to a provider a person picks. Visible to the browser's policy store; prefer a gateway that authenticates by other means where possible.

disabledFeatures.title: Disabled features
disabledFeatures.description: Feature ids to switch off, for example coaching-snapshot. Not case-sensitive. The full list of ids is in docs/deployment.md.

blockedTables.title: Tables that are never read or sent
blockedTables.description: Table names (not case-sensitive). Agent Buddy refuses to read these tables, including the table of a related record, a reference answer, the journal of such a record and tasks of such a class, and it never sends their records to an AI. Needs the content script to see this policy; see docs/deployment.md.

blockedFields.title: Fields that are never sent
blockedFields.description: Column names (not case-sensitive). A part of the request that is one of these columns, or that carries one (for example the list of linked incidents carries short_description and close_notes), is refused and nothing is sent.

sensitiveTablePrefixes.title: Extra sensitive table families
sensitiveTablePrefixes.description: Table-name prefixes that are treated like HR cases (for example x_acme_hr_ or x_acme_legal_): minimised reads, and no content sent unless allowHrContent is true. sn_hr_ is always included and cannot be removed here.

allowHrContent.title: Allow free text from HR cases
allowHrContent.description: HR case text is special-category personal data. It is excluded unless this is true AND the AI endpoint is pinned by this policy (aiProvider or aiBaseUrl) or runs on this computer. Without that, runs on HR content are refused.

tokenBudgetPerDay.title: Daily token budget per person
tokenBudgetPerDay.description: Counted per person per day on this computer from the local usage log. When used tokens reach this number no further AI call is made until tomorrow. A person's own lower cap in Settings still applies.

auditExport.title: Allow audit log export
auditExport.description: true (the default) lets people export the local activity log as CSV; false hides the export.

coachingEnabled.title: Enable the coaching snapshot
coachingEnabled.description: Reviews samples of closed tickets against a rubric. Off by default; confirm HR and works-council requirements first.

disablePageBar.title: Switch off the quick-actions bar on ServiceNow pages
disablePageBar.description: The only thing Agent Buddy shows inside a ServiceNow page is a small bar of main actions (a tab on the edge of the page). Set this to true to remove it for everyone; the side panel is not affected.

aiEnabled.title: AI Assist on
aiEnabled.description: false hides every AI Assist half and every AI action for everyone: Agent Buddy then works without AI (the Insights halves, which send nothing anywhere, stay). Leave unset or true to allow AI under the other keys.

disabledSections.title: Hidden screens
disabledSections.description: Screens of the panel to hide for everyone: mywork, team, write, knowledge. The Ticket screen cannot be hidden. Not case-sensitive; other words are ignored.

allowedProfiles.title: Allowed work profiles
allowedProfiles.description: Work profiles people may choose: it (IT service desk / resolver), req (request fulfilment), csm (customer service), hr (HR service delivery), lead (team lead), km (knowledge manager), mpc (major incident, problem, change). Leave unset to allow all. The hr profile also needs to be named here or allowHrContent to be true.

lockedProfiles.title: Locked work profiles
lockedProfiles.description: Work profiles set for everyone (ids as in allowedProfiles); people cannot change them. Leave unset to let people choose.

orgSnippets.title: Organisation snippets
orgSnippets.description: Canned replies published for everyone, read-only in the panel: a list of objects with a text title (up to 80 characters), a text body (up to 4000) and an optional shortcut. Plain text only; at most 200 are used.

orgFormats.title: Formats for AI answers
orgFormats.description: How some AI actions write their answer, for everyone: a list of objects, each with the "feature" (the action's id, for example record-summary), and any of: "sections" (a list of { "name", "hint" } for the ticket summary, the hand-off brief and the discussion catch-up), "style" (lines or bullets), "words" (30 to 500) and "extra" (a few sentences of extra instructions, up to 600 characters). "locked": true stops people changing that action. The rules about facts, customer safety and language always stay. At most 40 are used.

internalPhrases.title: Internal-only phrases
internalPhrases.description: Words and phrases the safe-to-send check flags in text going to a customer (internal team names, system names, project code names), on top of the built-in list. Not case-sensitive.

defaultDashboard.title: Organisation dashboard
defaultDashboard.description: One Team-screen dashboard for everyone: exactly what "Save layout as a file" writes for one dashboard, { "kind": "agentbuddy-dashboard-layout", "version": 1, "dashboard": { "name", "scope", "tables", "widgets" } }, at most 60000 characters. People with no dashboards yet start with it; others can add it from the dashboard menu. It is never locked. Leave "tables" out for every table (do not write null). A value that is not such a layout, or holds no section this version knows, is ignored.

priorityAccounts.title: Priority accounts
priorityAccounts.description: Customer accounts marked "Priority account" on customer service cases, written as ServiceNow shows the account's name (case and spaces do not matter). At most 500 names of up to 100 characters; longer names and values that are not text are ignored.
